rows.grounds: Compound: janma-nāmā-mahāvidyā (the great knowledge named 'birth') + aṃkuśa-antar-vidarbhitā (interwoven within the hook); accusative feminine singular qualifying the visualized image.

items.question: How is the great knowledge named Birth to be visualized in relation to the hook?
premises: The practitioner is instructed to visualize a beautiful, adorned image.
This visualization includes the great knowledge named Birth.
The great knowledge named Birth is interwoven within the hook.
items.inference: The visualization of the adorned image must specifically place the great knowledge named Birth within the hook.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'janma-nāmā' as a specific mantra or epithet is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: One should visualize her as interwoven within the hook, embodying the great knowledge named Birth.
